answer_4.quote: Manual Evaluation. ... Three annotators are employed to rate the samples. (1) Fluency (Flu.): is the response fluent? (2) Coherence (Coh.): is the response serve as a valid continuation of the preceding post? (3) Interesting (Int.): is the response generic? (4) Richness (Rich.): do the three sampled responses express different semantics?
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated responses on fluency, coherence, interestingness (inverse of generic), and richness (semantic diversity of multiple responses) using a 0-2 scale.
